content.text: Setting up a sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-broken-here|COREMERCH guide to digital]] store is a four-step sequence that most creators overcomplicate by starting in the wrong order. Step one is the backend: Cloudflare Workers or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-what-actually-9|google]] Apps Script handles [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-works-how|How Payment]] verification, order logging, and product delivery. Step two is the payment layer: NOWPayments connects your wallet addresses to the checkout flow — no KYC required from you or your buyer. Step three is the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serves your store for free with no server management. Step four is testing: complete a real mainnet transaction, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Only after step four passes cleanly should you promote the store. COREMERCH deploys the complete Edge Stack — Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments — in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass traditional payment platforms, instead leveraging blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies to facilitate transactions. This approach ensures that creators maintain control over their stores and products, without relying on third-party services that may be subject to restrictions or failures. By deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, creators can tap into this infrastructure and start selling their products with ease.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, creators need to have a clear understanding of their product offerings, target audience, and branding. They should also have a GitHub account, a Cloudflare account, and a basic understanding of HTML and CSS. Additionally, creators should familiarize themselves with the Edge Commerce Stack, a comprehensive solution that provides a pre-configured digital store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up the payment and delivery pipeline, creators need to integrate their digital store with a payment gateway such as NOWPayments. This involves generating an API key, configuring the payment settings, and testing the payment flow. Creators should also set up a file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to ensure that customers receive their products instantly after payment confirmation.
Deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once the digital store is set up and configured, creators can go live and start processing transactions. This involves testing the store's functionality, ensuring that the payment and delivery pipelines are working correctly, and promoting the store to potential customers. With the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can rest assured that their store is built on a robust and scalable infrastructure, capable of handling a high volume of transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As the digital store grows and attracts more customers, creators need to scale their infrastructure to ensure that it can handle the increased traffic and transaction volume. This involves monitoring the store's performance, optimizing the payment and delivery pipelines, and upgrading the infrastructure as needed. With the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can easily scale their store and expand their product offerings, without worrying about the underlying infrastructure.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Leverage sovereign commerce infrastructure for independence.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, provides a robust and scalable infrastructure for digital creators, enabling them to build and deploy their own digital stores with ease. This solution is particularly useful for creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, creators should follow these steps: set up a GitHub account, create a Cloudflare account, configure the payment and delivery pipelines, test the store's functionality, and promote the store to potential customers. Additionally, creators should familiarize themselves with the Edge Commerce Stack and consider upgrading to this solution to ensure a robust and scalable infrastructure.

Creators can scale their digital store by monitoring its performance, optimizing the payment and delivery pipelines, and upgrading the infrastructure as needed.
